aboutText:
I work at the intersection of storytelling, human rights and environmental justice. My work focuses on Indigenous rights, frontline communities and environmental issues across Southeast Asia.

I have produced written and visual stories, human rights defender profiles, communications campaigns, briefers and community organiser profiles for NGOs including EarthRights International and Justice & Peace Netherlands (Shelter City Network).
contactLine: Open to communications, storytelling, and research roles.
